name: NBCFDC New Swarnima Scheme for OBC Women
description: Concessional credit scheme by NBCFDC (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment) providing term loans up to ₹20 Lakh at 5% interest rate to empower rural women entrepreneurs belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC).
nodalAgency: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
targetAudience: Women entrepreneurs belonging to OBC / EBC categories in rural & semi-urban areas
